enableSonnet1M.desc: Show Sonnet 1M in the model selector. Requires extra usage on Max, Team, and Enterprise plans. API and Pro users need extra usage.

customModels.desc: Append additional Claude model IDs to the picker, one per line. Environment model overrides still replace the picker.

enableBangBash.desc: Type ! on empty input to enter bash mode. Runs commands directly via Node.js child_process. Requires view reopen.

tabBarPosition.desc: Choose where to display tab badges and action buttons

enableAutoScroll.name: Auto-scroll during streaming
enableAutoScroll.desc: Automatically scroll to the bottom as Claude streams responses. Disable to stay at the top and read from the beginning.

showAgentEditedFiles.name: Show files changed by the agent
showAgentEditedFiles.desc: List the files the agent creates or edits above the chat input so you can open them with one click. Turn off to keep the previous silent behavior.

deferMathRenderingDuringStreaming.name: Defer math rendering during streaming
deferMathRenderingDuringStreaming.desc: Show raw LaTeX while responses stream, then render math once when each text block completes.

collapseStreamingResponse.name: Hide incomplete responses while streaming
collapseStreamingResponse.desc: Show a 'Writing response...' placeholder while a response streams, then render each text block in one pass when it completes — avoids showing half-formed Markdown or XML.

expandFileEditsByDefault.name: Expand file edits by default
expandFileEditsByDefault.desc: Show Write and Edit diffs expanded when they first appear.

onboarding.heading: Set up Specorator
onboarding.subheading: Pick the coding agents you want to use, then confirm a few vault defaults. Everything here is also in Settings, and every change saves as you make it.

providers.heading: Choose your providers
providers.intro: Specorator drives agent CLIs you install yourself. Providers already on this machine are listed first — switch on the ones you want to use.
providers.unknownNoResolver: Couldn't check this one yet — reload the plugin, then use Check again.
providers.unknownExternal: Runs {command} on another target (such as WSL), which can't be checked from here.

providers.batchShim: {path} is a .cmd shim, which {command} can't be launched from — point this at the native executable (.exe) instead.
providers.missingNode: {path} needs Node.js to run, and Node isn't on your PATH. Install Node.js — or use the native installer, which needs none — then check again.
providers.unsupportedForm: Windows can't start {path} the way this provider launches it — point this at the native executable (.exe).
providers.authHint: Not signed in yet? Run {command} once in a terminal.

install.manualPathClearHint: Leave blank to clear the path and go back to auto-detection.

defaults.heading: Chat defaults
defaults.intro: Sensible starting points for every new conversation. You can change any of these from the chat toolbar later.
defaults.permissionDesc: New conversations ask before an agent writes files or runs commands. Plan mode and skipping approvals are per-conversation toolbar choices — Plan is deliberately not a saved default, since the app resets it on restart.
defaults.titlesDesc: Generates a short title from your first message.
defaults.needsProvider: Enable a provider on the previous step to pick a default model.

folders.heading: Vault folders
folders.intro: Work orders, templates, loops, and quick actions are plain Markdown notes in your vault. Confirm where they should live.
folders.blank: Not configured — this surface stays disabled

workspace.heading: Where chat lives
workspace.intro: Specorator chat can sit in a sidebar or take a full editor tab.
workspace.maxTabsDesc: Each open tab holds its own live agent session.

marketplace.heading: Marketplace (optional)
marketplace.intro: The Marketplace installs ready-made agents, skills, loops, templates, and quick actions. It fetches a remote catalog, so it stays off until you enable it.
marketplace.enable: Allow the Marketplace to fetch its catalog

finish.heading: You're set
finish.intro: Open a chat tab and send your first message. The Library, Agent Board, and Marketplace are on the left ribbon.
finish.noProviders: No provider is enabled yet — chat will stay empty until you turn one on.
finish.reopenHint: You can reopen this guide any time from the command palette: "Open setup guide".
